title: Correctness of a snapshot block
statement: Let $M$ be a finite binary Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $\ell$ be a finite list of bit sources, and let $T,t\in\mathbb{N}$ with $t\le T$. For every input word $x$ and list of Boolean blocks such that, at each index $i$ below the snapshot-block index for time $t$, block $i$ equals the configuration expansion specified by $\ell$ on the source values from $x$, evaluating the padded snapshot sources for time $t$ on $x$ and those blocks and applying the configuration update for a snapshot gives exactly the snapshot expansion of $M$ on the source values from $x$ at time $t$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite binary Turing machine
